about: Clairic's replies from a live probe of @cf/cloudflare/clairic on 2026-10-22, one case per request: the HTTP status and the reply body byte for byte (no headers), the number of fields the request sent, and, where a test or the conformance suite sends the same request again, the state and the fields as role fields (sent). Each body is read with provider::read_reply and becomes item, the item a module answers with: a success forwards the answers (number text, spans and unknown members untouched), truncated, state_text and usage; an error maps by Workers AI code, then by status (5006 at HTTP 400 and 3030 at HTTP 422 are not in the table, so both are invalid_item), with the status, code and the provider's message in the item error's message. Every success bills input_tokens = schema_tokens + passes x state_tokens + image_tokens, with passes at most the field count; no error reply carries usage.
